messages:
lauren: Heads up — I’m seeing a weird accounting delta from a streaming + toolcall flow. Console shows ~120 tokens for the request but the ledger ended up with ~320 after a reconnect + truncation. Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:
omar: Can you paste the trace id or router id? could be a fallback to a different model variant we didn’t credit-match.
lauren: trace=rt-9f3a, router=user-east-2. Here’s the logs around the reconnect:```[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] session rt-9f3a stream open model=mosaic-8b
[2026-03-18T14:02:14Z] session rt-9f3a toolcall start tool=code-runner
[2026-03-18T14:02:15Z] connection lost, client reconnecting
[2026-03-18T14:02:16Z] fallback route -> model=mosaic-8b-quant (shorter kv cache)
[2026-03-18T14:02:17Z] stream truncated by server at token 110, toolcall aborted
[2026-03-18T14:02:18Z] provisional credit 120 tokens issued
[2026-03-18T14:02:20Z] final ledger appended 320 tokens for session rt-9f3a```
sasha: That looks like the classic "prefix capture + fallback variant" mismatch. If the fallback path generates a longer serialized toolcall payload on resume (different prompt framing/kv eviction) the accounting heuristic counts extra tokens and the provisional credit isn’t subtracted correctly.
mike: We have two separate issues here: (1) provisional vs final accounting race (provisional created at truncation, final appended after routing decision), (2) session id reuse on reconnect causing attribution to the same session ledger but different route metrics.
lauren: Is the short-term mitigation to revoke provisional credits when final ledger arrives? Right now the console shows a provisional credit and then a large final charge so it looks like a billing bug to customers.
omar: We tried auto-revoke before but it caused spikes in charge churn. Customers saw refunds then chargebacks. Better to show provisional state explicitly in UI until reconciliation completes.
ben: From product: agreed on showing provisional state, but how long do we hold reconciliation? We need a deterministic SLA for enterprise reporting.
mike: Propose: extend the provisional window to 30s for streams, and in the ledger attach a parent_retry_id so we can diff tokens across variants during reconcile. Also emit telemetry tag retry.sampler=on so backfills can identify fallback-generated deltas.
sasha: Implementation caveat: adding parent_retry_id requires us to carry the original model variant and prefix-length at reconnect — we might need to persist per-session minimal snapshot to avoid incorrect attribution when kv evicts.
lauren: I can add a small patch to the router to persist snapshot {model, prefix_len, session_ts} for 60s. That should make diffing feasible.
billing-bot: Automated: reconciliation job queued for rt-9f3a; provisional adjustments pending. Ticket #INFR-4542 created.
omar: Follow-up: we should add a console column "provisional → final" in billing drilldown and a trace link that overlays token-by-token deltas. Small UX change, big clarity win.
ben: Approved as a canary UX change for next release — show provisional flag and reconciled final, + expose reconciliation timestamp in enterprise CSVs.
lauren: Thanks. I’ll open the PR for router snapshot + telemetry. Will also attach sample logs and a small test harness.
mike: After PR, schedule a small canary in eu-west-1 for 6 hours and monitor provisional reconciliation rate. If >0.5% sessions mismatch, rollback.
sasha: Also add a unit test around truncated toolcall accounting that simulates reconnect -> fallback model -> truncated stream.
lauren: Sounds good. I’ll post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
